_what_this_is: Registry of CAMERA EVENTS. These are not models we host - they are task-based events the camera already produces, each with a fixed input and output structure. We consume them; we never invoke them.

_field_guide.cpp_result: POPULATES prompt section 2 (TYPES) - the C++ type copied from ai_tasks/common/include
_field_guide.accepts: USED BY edge check condition 1 - which semantic tags may feed this event
_field_guide.emits: USED BY edge check condition 1 - the semantic tag this event produces
_field_guide.subtypes: USED BY edge check condition 1 - tags this event can narrow to (class_id selects which)
_field_guide.provides: POPULATES prompt section 6 (input provides) AND edge check condition 2 - the fields present in the emitted event
_field_guide.note: human reference only, never enters a prompt

_tracker_note: object_detection and instance_segmentation ALWAYS ship with a tracker attached. track_id is always populated - it is part of the event, not a separate stage. Events without a tracker (pose, depth, segmentation, face, plate) do not provide track_id, and any block requiring it cannot consume them.

object_detection.note: Tracker is attached. track_id is always present and stable across frames. class_id selects which subtype this detection is.

instance_segmentation.note: Superset of object_detection - adds mask_rle. Anything accepting region.object accepts this.

pose_estimation.note: COCO 17-keypoint skeleton. NO tracker - provides no track_id, so blocks requiring it cannot consume this directly.

monocular_depth.note: RELATIVE depth, not metric. No boxes, no ids - cannot drive any box-based block.

semantic_segmentation.note: Per-pixel classes with NO instance separation. Sees people but cannot say which person, so it can never count them.

vision_language.note: L2-normalised vector. The cross-camera identity mechanism if re-ID is ever needed.

face_detection.note: SAME C++ type as object_detection, DIFFERENT semantic tag. This is exactly why the edge check reads tags, not types.

license_plate_detection.note: Runs on a full frame or a vehicle crop. Never on a person or face crop.

anpr.note: ACCEPTS ONLY region.license_plate. A face crop can never satisfy this.
